# fco_managed_vm_ldap_directories (Data Source)

Lists all LDAP directories available to the tenant.

Access the results via `fco_managed_vm_ldap_directories.<name>.ldap_directories`.

## Example Usage

```terraform
# List all LDAP directories available to the tenant.
data "fco_managed_vm_ldap_directories" "all" {
}

# Access with `fco_managed_vm_ldap_directories.all.ldap_directories`.
# e.g. fco_managed_vm_ldap_directories.all.ldap_directories[0].uuid
```

<!-- schema generated by tfplugindocs -->
## Schema

### Read-Only

- `id` (String) A content hash identifying the current set of listed LDAP directories.
- `ldap_directories` (Attributes List) The list of LDAP directories available to the tenant. (see [below for nested schema](#nestedatt--ldap_directories))

<a id="nestedatt--ldap_directories"></a>
### Nested Schema for `ldap_directories`

Read-Only:

- `fqdn` (String) The FQDN of the LDAP directory.
- `tenant` (String) The tenant this LDAP directory belongs to.
- `uuid` (String) The UUID of the LDAP directory.
